metrics.name: descent_rate_fps
metrics.notes: Steady terminal descent for a flat circular projected area.

source.title: NASA Glenn terminal velocity reference
source.derivation: Evaluate sqrt(2*m*g/(rho*Cd*A)) with the stated chute diameter, Cd, mass, and ISA sea-level density.

comparison.decisionRule: Observed terminal descent rate differs from the analytic reference by no more than the stated absolute tolerance.

notes: Analytic regression comparison only; not parachute test evidence.
